values.binNote: The wiki's 'Total Physical Damage' row is 2x the initial cast's TalonR#Damage (BaseDamage x2, ad ratio x2), because both the outward pass and the recast convergence deal TalonR#Damage separately; the bin has no calculation for the doubled total, it's just the same TalonR#Damage instance applied twice.

values.meaning: lingers at maximum range for up to seconds before automatic recast
values.quote: lingers at maximum range for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds

values.meaning: minimum lifetime before convergence can be recast
values.quote: ''Shadow Assault'' has a minimum lifetime of {{fd|0.8}} seconds before convergence.
values.binNote: No bin row for this minimum-recast-delay timer; it's not exposed as a separate data value in the sheet (only overall Duration=2.5 is present).

mechanics.claim: The outward cast deals damage to enemies it passes through as blades disperse in a ring, separate from the recast convergence damage.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies it passes through and lingers for a short time

mechanics.claim: Recast converges the blades back and deals the same physical damage a second time, so hitting a single stationary target with both passes yields the 'Total Physical Damage' figure.
mechanics.quote: '''Talon''' breaks stealth and converges the blades to him, dealing the same {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Breaking stealth with a basic attack or Noxian Diplomacy converges the blades onto the attacked target instead of Talon, and using a basic attack breaks stealth at the end of the attack windup.
mechanics.quote: Breaking stealth with a basic attack or ''{{ai|Noxian Diplomacy|Talon}}'' will converge the blades to the target instead.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks only a single pass of the blades (not the whole ability).
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block a single pass.

mechanics.claim: Shadow Assault does not interrupt or cancel Talon's basic attacks.
mechanics.quote: ''Shadow Assault'' does not cancel '''Talon's''' basic attacks.

mechanics.claim: The ability casts 12 blades total, evenly spread in a ring, each a separate damage instance able to hit the same target as it passes through and again on return.
mechanics.quote: ''Shadow Assault'' casts a total of 12 blades evenly distributed in all directions.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts after the recast/return effect completes, not on initial cast.
